summary: Documented and enforced the application/runtime encoding and future-port admission rules without adding speculative production interfaces. The completed application artifact remains exactly one LiveCatalog class with only snapshot and commit methods and rejects universal environments/errors, service locators, capability registries, free programs, future-port placeholders, effect-wrapped pure facades, and runtime coordination vocabulary. The RFC-first architecture audit now identifies S-01 as the implemented runtime/admission foundation and distinguishes concurrency, streaming, wall/monotonic time, business/scoped atomicity, and telemetry/durable audit responsibilities. All 120 packaged adversarial tests passed. Automated review found no remaining stale runtime claim, speculative API promise, or boundary leak and is not canonical Verify or Human Review.
